etsy.title: Retro Arcade Rally Art, 80s Video Game Style Motorsport Poster, Rally Car Gift, Gamer Garage Decor
etsy.description:
A retro arcade rally art print styled like a game-over screen: CONTINUE? with a big 9 on the countdown and the service park in 30 min.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang in a garage, man cave, office, game room, or on a rally fan's wall.

No team, series, or manufacturer marks: just generic rally humor.

This listing is a physical poster print. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Retro arcade racing posters are mostly licensed game art (named classic racing titles) or kart parodies, many as digital downloads; no generic rally continue-screen design surfaced.
Arcade listings lean on 'gift for him' and 'gamer gift' gift wording alongside 70s/80s era words.

searchPhrases: retro rally car wall art poster unframed garage
funny racing sign poster man cave garage
competitorNotes: Amazon rally prints are mostly watercolor real-car paintings sold unframed in 8x10 to 16x20, pitched for garage and man cave walls and as a gift for car enthusiasts.
Funny racing wall decor on Amazon is dominated by 8x12 metal tin signs (speed-limit and parking jokes); no co-driver or pace-note jokes surfaced.

research.notes: Primary keyword joins the indexed 'retro arcade racing' and 'rally art' to match the arcade styling; no game titles or publishers are named. 'gamer gift' appears in a competitor title, not confirmed as indexed. No priceRange: prices seen were for digital downloads.
